scope: C1 TCU geometry is unmodified 128 MAC/cycle, not the earlier forced 64. Native DSP mapping; 100 MHz nominal reference; separately synthesized block costs added, not integrated timing or sustained throughput.
memory: LMEM 8/32 banks, 512 KiB, 8 B; cache 1/4 banks, 4 MiB, 16 B words, 64 B lines; AXI 1/4 inputs, 32 transport groups and 32 physical outputs, 64 B, 34-bit physical address, interleave enabled. FP-INT has an additional 256 KiB ACC.
